name: Struggle
overview: Scripture teaches that struggles are met with the assurance of God's sovereign care and guidance. The LORD is portrayed as a shepherd and a source of strength and light, providing peace and protection amid difficulties (Psalms 23:1; Psalms 27:1). Believers are called to trust fully in God rather than their own understanding, confident that He has plans for their good and a hopeful future (Proverbs 3:5; Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus Christ is revealed as the ultimate way to the Father, the light shining in darkness, offering true life and victory over fear and despair (John 1:5; John 14:6).
